false_claims: Minor imprecision: it calls 6.7GB "可用物理内存". The repo records 6.7G total memory, and the draft measured only about 2.3GB available with services running.
Y.actionable: yes: same sound path (JetPack 5, L4T-matched llama.cpp built for sm_72, 1.5B Q4 model, check the board first, adapt bootstrap), plus a correct warning that the Tailscale ACL is allow-all. It does not say to confirm SSH access first.

why: The two outputs are nearly equal on traps. Y adds correct, repo-backed points X lacks: the allow-all Tailscale policy (confirmed in nas-config/tailscale/policy.hujson), JetPack 6/7 not supporting Xavier, and explicit sm_72/no-SBSA/Orin image guidance. X's only edge is citing the JetPack 5.1.5 record explicitly.
